_doc: Fork only: when a failed Fork tests run gets its one automatic re-run. Read by .github/scripts/fork-ci-rerun.py
(.github/workflows/fork-ci-rerun.yml every 10 minutes); the script has no fact about this repository, these are
signs: regular expressions matched against a failed job's annotations (GitHub's own messages).
lost: the runner went away; enough on its own.
limit: the job or a step ran past its time limit; only with the job's pressure note showing `stalled`.
stalled: the job's memory pressure note (.github/scripts/fork-ci-pressure.py) shows the machine or the job's box
stalled: some-or-all-tasks-waiting (full) share of the job's time, or the 5-minute full average at its end.
memory_full: any failure, when the note shows the box full: OOM kills, memory.max hits, or memory.high
throttling with a full stall share at least high_events_with_full_share_percent.
skip_when: with this environment variable (the workflow sets it from a repository variable) at one of these
values, a run that qualifies is only reported, not re-run (fleet mode: a re-run of failed jobs would wait for
